content: लाक्षणिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [लक्षणया बोधयति ठक्] .²1 One who is acquainted with marks or signs. .²2 Characteristic, indicatory. .²3 Having a secondary sense, used in a secondary sense (as a word, as distinguished from वाच्य and व्यञ्जक <ab>qq. vv.</ab>); स्याद्वाचको लाक्षणिकः शब्दोऽत्र व्यञ्जकस्त्रिधा <ls>K. P. 2</ls>. .²4 Expressing indirectly or figuratively. .²5 Secondary, inferior; साक्षात् सुधांशुर्मुखमेव भैम्या दिवः स्फुटं लाक्षणिकः शशाङ्कः <ls>N. 10. 115</ls>. .²6 Technical. .{@-कः@} A technical term.
